what_this_measures: This audit reads the 43 cardiology topics from the batch1 completeness file, chooses the maintained delivered tabbed HTML page where scripts/verify_delivered_bytes.py declares one, otherwise uses the sole tabbed root-page match, and slices each projector-emitted tab from id="pn-<tab>" to <!--end-<tab>-->. For every assessable panel it records the banner state, visible text length after the opening banner, literal record-card counts, table/svg/list tag counts, and a semantic contradiction judgement for NOT_HELD panels with visible body text.
